hero.h1: Five Service Lines. One Company That Cares.
hero.subtitle: Every service we offer exists because we saw a real problem going unsolved. No bundles, no upsells, no surprises.

cta.heading: Not Sure Which Service Fits?
cta.body: Tell us about your situation — we'll recommend the right fit with no pressure.

services.name: White Glove Managed IT
services.body: Dedicated remote IT support, SLA-backed response, and real humans who know your systems before you call. One flat fee covers unlimited support, proactive monitoring, and security patching. No offshore call centers. No automated runaround. No surprise invoices.
features: Dedicated technician — same person every time

services.name: Hardware-as-a-Service (HaaS)
services.body: Enterprise-grade refurbished hardware on a flat monthly subscription. We source, configure, deploy, and manage every device. When hardware ages out, we refresh it — and the old equipment is responsibly recycled, not landfilled. Zero e-waste from our clients, ever.

services.name: AI Custom App Development
services.body: Stop paying $800/mo for a stack of SaaS tools that don't talk to each other. We build a custom AI-powered application that replaces your subscriptions — and you own the code outright. No recurring license fees. Hosted on our solar-powered Kansas servers. Most clients see ROI payback in under 18 months.
features: You own 100% of the code — forever

services.name: Senior Technology Concierge
services.body: Technology shouldn't be stressful. Our Senior Technology Concierge delivers scam-proof security, device setup, and monthly check-ins — in plain English, at your pace, with real dignity. We built this because Big Tech left seniors behind. We didn't.
features: Plain-English support — no jargon, no rush
Emergency tech card provided at onboarding

services.name: Sovereign Private Hosting
services.body: Your data lives in Park City, Kansas — in our facility, on our servers, under your terms. Solar-powered. HIPAA-ready. No Big Tech surveillance. No third-party scanning. No data monetization. Just fast, private, sovereign hosting for your websites, apps, and data.
